notes.text: The linked baraita has students addressing Rabbi Yehudah ben Ro’etz. Earlier on [the same folio](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.4a.2), Rabbi Yitzchak bar Yose reports in Rabbi Yochanan’s name that Rabbi Yehudah follows the vocalized reading. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1650&lang=en) cites Sanhedrin and adds parallels.
